hero.subtitle: "For protecting your exceptional objects is an art that transcends time."

story.title: The Spirit of the Manufacture
story.intro: Every creation is conceived as an encounter between artisanal heritage, noble materials and contemporary rigour.
story.paragraph1: Our manufacture has existed for fifteen years. It has crafted exceptional cases and presentation boxes for major luxury houses, under confidentiality agreements that bind us never to name them.
story.paragraph2: L'Écrin Français is the brand we are creating to open this same manufacture, the same craftsmen and the same standard of finish, directly to individuals and small businesses.
story.paragraph3: Nothing is produced on an assembly line: every case is still made to order, on a deliberately non-automated line — the time it takes to stay authentic, not the pace of a factory.
story.imageCaption: Noble materials, meticulous finishing and constant attention to detail.

card1.title: Full-Circle Craftsmanship
card1.text: No intermediaries. From selecting the tree to fitting the last hinge, every detail is considered to endure and to seduce.

card2.title: The Art of Bespoke
card2.text: Millimetre-precise dimensions, hot stamping or laser engraving: we give shape to your most exacting ideas.

card3.title: From a Single Piece to a Series
card3.text: A single piece or a limited series, every order follows the same exacting standard of beauty and rigour — with tiered pricing for volume orders.
